on Thursday it authorized an additional $510M for share repurchases, raising the total available authorization to $700M.
An additional $100M of share repurchases will be executed immediately through a 10b5-1 program.
The company expects total share repurchases of $460M in 2026, compared with $466M last year.
The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.26 per share, payable Oct. 9 to shareholders of record as of Sept. 25.
The company will carry $600M in remaining buyback authorization into 2027.

title: Curtiss-Wright raises share repurchase authorization to $700M
